failure_summary.description: The reply was applied to an already-cached domain (flights or restaurants) with an earlier constraint re-passed. The last message actually called for a first search of an uncached domain (restaurants), or for dates to be searched (flights and hotels). Seen in T4, T5, T7.
'Yeah, Summerlin would be great' produced budget=55 (the previous reply) instead of neighborhood=['Summerlin'] (T2).
The hotel search was dropped when the reply gave a stay length (T3). Only one leg was filtered when raw and filtered flight keys coexisted, so the return leg was skipped (T8).
Hotel dates were copied from the skill's own example dates when none were given (T1). num_people=4 was inferred from the assistant's wording rather than a number the user stated (T6).

patch.reasoning: Most failures are routing errors: the agent works on whichever domain already has a cache key instead of the domain the last message's words point to. Edit 1 replaces the opening SEARCH GATE sentence with a shorter domain-first gate. It keeps the existing three-line filter instruction and adds the cases the batch missed: a touched domain with no key gets a first search, an untouched domain gets zero lines, a date reply searches the requested flight and hotel domains, 'for N nights' uses adjust_date, and a neighbourhood reply passes only the neighbourhood. Edit 2 fixes the flight-leg count when raw and filtered keys coexist, and covers the flights-only 'under N' budget reply. Edit 3 removes the literal example dates that were named in the skill and copied into T1's search. Edit 4 stops num_people being inferred from the assistant's text. The edits replace or tighten existing sentences rather than adding new gates.

edits.target: - SEARCH GATE (do this first): read the CACHE dict. If a domain's key is present, search_* is forbidden for that domain, whatever the reply adds (cuisine, rating, budget, time, amenity, neighborhood, or interest in the assistant's proposal such as 'Sure', 'Yes', 'What's there?').
edits.content: - DOMAIN-FIRST GATE (do this first): decide which domains the LAST user message touches from its own words. A date, 'X to Y', 'return' or 'for N nights' -> the flight and/or hotel the user requested in any turn that has no key. Cuisine, allergy, dietary word or 'food' -> restaurants. Stars, amenity, rooms, per-night price or neighborhood -> hotels. Class, airline, time of day or ticket price -> flights. Attraction type or name -> attractions. A domain the message does not touch gets ZERO lines, even if its key is in CACHE and an earlier turn said 'business', 'first', a cuisine or a budget: the cached entry already holds it. A touched domain with NO key gets its first search_* now, carrying every constraint stated in any turn (city = trip destination; hotel check-in/out from the flight dates). Example: CACHE has flights + hotels and the message is only a dietary need plus a cuisine -> a single `search_restaurants(city=<trip city>, <dietary flag>=True, cuisine=[...])` + save, and no flight filter. A date reply after the assistant asked for dates searches every requested flight/hotel domain that has no key, even if only 'restaurants' is cached. Several candidate dates for one leg go in one departure_date / checkin_date list. 'for N nights' -> `checkout_date = adjust_date(date="<check-in date as written>", delta_days=N)` and the hotel search goes in the same block as the flight search. A touched domain whose key is present: search_* is forbidden for that domain, whatever the reply adds (cuisine, rating, budget, time, amenity, a 'Yes'). Pass only the NEW constraint from the last message. A place name answering a neighborhood question -> neighborhood=["<place>"] only, never the previous reply's budget.

edits.target: 2 keys -> 2 blocks, 3 keys -> 3 blocks; stopping after the first key is wrong.
edits.content: Count LEGS, not keys: a raw key and its filtered_* version are ONE leg (load only the filtered one). departure_flights + return_flights + filtered_departure_flights + filtered_return_flights = 2 legs = 2 blocks, each loading its filtered key. 3 legs -> 3 blocks. Stopping after the first leg is wrong. In a flights-only conversation, an 'affordable under N' / 'under N' reply is budget=N on EVERY leg.

edits.target: Never use a TOOL CONFIG example date such as '2025-08-03', and never reuse a date that appears only in this skill's examples (May 16/18/19/26, 2025 and similar).
edits.content: Never use a TOOL CONFIG example date such as '2025-08-03', and never use any date that is not written in a user message of the CONVERSATION. Dates inside this skill's examples are illustrations only.

edits.target: - Pass only values the user literally stated. Never invent an airline from words like 'kid-friendly'.
edits.content: - Pass only values the user literally stated. num_people / num_rooms come only from a number the USER wrote ('we'll need 2 rooms' -> num_rooms=2 only; the assistant's 'for 2 people' or a 'family / kids' mention gives no num_people). Never invent an airline from words like 'kid-friendly'.
